Sub: Draft delegation of administrative powers for the purpose of Rule 18 of
the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 - reg.

Madam/Sir,

In order to further rationalize the work a relating to processing of applications
under Rule 18 of Ccs(Conduct) Rules,1964, Revised Delegation of administrative
Powers is enclosed herewith in Annexure-I.

2. It is requested that the proposed delegation may be gone through and kindly
provide your comments on the proposed delegation within 10 days from the date of
issue and by 21/06/2019 for taking further necessary action in this matter. The
comments on the proposed delegation may be provided by email at
rc.hrm@epfindia.gov.in by the specified date.

Yours faithfully,

Encl: Draft delegation of administrative
Powers attached as Annexure-I.

as
(Udita Chowdhary)
AddI.Central P.F. Commissioner (HRM)

Copy to: RPFC,(NDC) with the request to upload on the website of EPFO.
